spx.note_en: Monday was a split screen, and the split is worth seeing. The index closed at 7,652.86, down just 0.28% — but underneath, the chip shares were sold hard while almost everything else held. The Dow actually rose 140.15 points, and market reports describe money rotating out of the riskier technology shares and into steadier blue-chip names. What sent the chips down was new, and specific: reports said Nvidia has told customers that servers built around its AI chips will cost more than 15% more from early next year, because memory chips have become so expensive. Micron fell 5.83%, Broadcom 2.63%, and the chip gauge lost 2.67%. The bond market, for once, went the friendly way: after a report that the Treasury may fund its bigger bond buying from its own $1 trillion account, the 10-year rate eased to about 4.70% and the 30-year to about 5.23%, off last week's 19-year high. And the Treasury Secretary's Iran plan landed at 11 in the morning Pacific time — more than 60 people, companies and ships sanctioned — after which oil fell about 2% rather than rising. The index now sits about 1.9% below its August 13 record. The fear gauge closed at 15.85.

spx.verdict_en: What I'd watch: tomorrow, twice. At 5:30 in the morning Pacific time the July inflation report the Fed watches most closely arrives, with GDP and durable-goods orders the same morning. After the close, Nvidia reports — the largest company in this index, and the one whose shares have now fallen seven sessions in a row. Then Friday at 7 in the morning Pacific time the new Fed chair gives his first Jackson Hole speech, after his own July minutes showed three officials already voting to raise rates. Yesterday handed the bond market a good day for a change — long rates eased on a report that the Treasury may fund its bigger bond buying out of its own $1 trillion account — and whether that lasts longer than last week's single day of relief still decides more than any one earnings report. The Iran plan is now off the calendar and onto the record: more than 60 people, companies and ships sanctioned, and oil fell about 2% on the day rather than rising.

spx.bull_en: Monday is the encouraging version of a bad day for chips: the AI group was marked down again and the whole index gave up only 0.28%, because the money leaving technology went to other American companies rather than out of the market — the Dow rose 140 points. The bond market helped for the first time in a while, with long rates easing off their 19-year high after a report that the Treasury may fund its bigger bond buying from its own $1 trillion account, and those bigger buybacks actually begin September 9. Oil fell about 2% even as the toughest Iran sanctions yet were announced, which takes pressure off the inflation that rates are built from. And the economy underneath keeps testing well: Friday's business survey was the strongest since April 2022, jobless claims fell to 206,000, and most of the store chains beat.

spx.bear_en: The market's leadership is still being taken apart, and Monday gave the selling a concrete reason rather than a mood: Nvidia has reportedly told customers that AI servers will cost more than 15% more from early next year because memory has got so expensive. That is a cost the AI buildout has to absorb somewhere, and the index's biggest company reports tomorrow into exactly that question, having fallen seven days running. Long-term rates eased on a news report, not on a decision — a 30-year government bond still pays over 5%, and that competes with every expensive share in this index. Walmart's warning from Thursday still stands: the country's biggest retailer says its customers are slowing down. And the trade fight with Canada widened again — a threat to raise tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks, parts and steel to 50% in January, with Canada's own answer set for September 8.

AI 구축이 어딘가에서 떠안아야 할 비용이고, 이 지수에서 가장 큰 회사가 바로 그 질문 앞에서 내일 실적을 발표합니다. 일곱 거래일 연속 내린 채로요. 장기 금리가 내린 것은 결정이 아니라 보도 하나 때문이었습니다. 30년물 국채는 여전히 5% 넘게 주고, 그것은 이 지수의 모든 비싼 주식과 경쟁합니다. 목요일 월마트의 경고도 그대로 남아 있습니다. 미국에서 가장 큰 유통업체가 손님들의 소비가 느려지고 있다고 말했습니다. 그리고 캐나다와의 무역 다툼은 또 넓어졌습니다. 캐나다산 자동차·트럭·부품·철강 전부에 대한 관세를 1월부터 50%로 올리겠다는 위협이 나왔고, 캐나다의 응답은 9월 8일로 예고돼 있습니다.

qqq.note_en: Down 1.00% to $706.32 on Monday, and for once the reason was not a mood about prices. Reports said Nvidia — this fund's largest holding — has told customers that servers built around its AI chips will cost more than 15% more from early next year, because memory chips have become so expensive. That is a real bill, and the market marked down both ends of it: Nvidia fell 2.91%, and the memory makers that are charging more fell harder still — Micron −5.83%, with SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate all down over 5%. Broadcom fell 2.63% and AMD about 3%. The chip gauge lost 2.67%. The rest of the market did not follow: the Dow rose 140 points as money moved to steadier companies, which is why this fund fell three times as much as the S&P 500 did. The fund now sits about 5.7% below its 1-year high and is still up about 2.7% for August — with its largest holding reporting tomorrow, into the exact question Monday raised.

qqq.plain_en: A single fund holding the 100 largest non-bank companies on the Nasdaq — mostly technology. Buying one share gives you a slice of all of them. qqq.plain_ko: 나스닥에 상장된 회사 가운데 금융회사를 뺀 가장 큰 100개(대부분 기술 기업)를 한 번에 담은 펀드입니다. 이 펀드 한 주를 사면 그 회사들을 조금씩 나눠 갖는 셈입니다. 월요일에는 1.00% 내린 706.32달러가 됐습니다. qqq.bull_en: A price rise is not a demand problem. A company able to charge 15% more is a company whose customers have nowhere else to go, and Nvidia can tell that story out loud tomorrow. Meanwhile the pressure that did the damage earlier this month eased: long-term rates came off their 19-year high on Monday, and the Treasury's bigger bond buying begins September 9. The fund is about 2.7% ahead for August even after two rough weeks, and the money leaving technology went to other American shares rather than out of the market.

qqq.bear_en: Monday turned a mood into a number. If servers built around Nvidia's chips cost more than 15% more next year, the extra money comes out of somebody in this fund — the customers buying them, most of which are also in this fund, or Nvidia's own profit margin. nvda.note_en: Nvidia fell 2.91% on Monday to $208.48 — a seventh straight down day, which reporting calls its longest losing run in four years. The market did not wait — it marked down both ends, taking 5.83% off Micron and 2.63% off Broadcom the same day. On Monday it fell 2.91% to $208.48, its seventh down day in a row — the longest such run in four years — after reports that it has told customers its AI servers will cost more than 15% more from early next year, because memory chips have got expensive. It is still up about 3.9% for August, sits ≈ 11.9% below its record, and reports its own results tomorrow, Wednesday August 26 — the biggest dated event on this page.
nvda.plain_ko: 엔비디아는 인공지능을 돌리는 데 쓰이는 반도체를 만듭니다. 회사 가치가 약 5조 달러로 세계에서 가치가 가장 큰 회사 중 하나입니다. 월요일에는 2.91% 내린 208.48달러가 됐습니다. 일곱 거래일 연속 하락으로 4년 만에 가장 긴 행진이었습니다. 메모리 반도체가 비싸져서 AI 서버 가격을 내년 초부터 15% 넘게 올린다고 고객사들에 알렸다는 보도가 나온 뒤였습니다. 8월 누적으로는 여전히 약 3.9% 올라 있고, 최고가보다 약 11.9% 낮으며, 자체 실적은 내일 8월 26일 수요일에 발표합니다. 이 페이지에서 가장 큰 날짜 있는 일정입니다.
nvda.bull_en: Read the price rise the other way round: a company that can charge its customers 15% more is a company whose customers have nowhere else to go, and Nvidia gets to say so out loud tomorrow. Nothing has touched the demand — the memory shortage is the AI buildout made visible, SK Hynix just announced a record buyback on the strength of it, and the equipment makers reported records earlier this month. The OpenAI pledge, whatever else it raises, is demand written in concrete: the company has said OpenAI's plans could mean roughly $600 billion of its computing sold through 2030. Seven down days have lowered the bar to about 32 times profits the day before the report. China is reopening, and SpaceX has chosen Nvidia as its only chip supplier.
nvda.bull_ko: 가격 인상을 거꾸로 읽어 보십시오. 고객에게 값을 15% 더 받을 수 있는 회사는 고객이 달리 갈 곳이 없는 회사이고, 엔비디아는 내일 그 이야기를 직접 할 수 있습니다. 수요를 건드린 것은 아무것도 없습니다. 메모리 품귀는 AI 구축이 눈에 보이게 된 것이고, SK하이닉스는 그 힘을 바탕으로 방금 사상 최대 자사주 매입을 발표했으며, 장비 회사들은 이달 초 사상 최대 실적을 냈습니다. OpenAI 보증은 어떤 질문을 낳든 콘크리트에 새겨진 수요이기도 합니다. 회사는 OpenAI의 계획이 2030년까지 약 6,000억 달러어치의 컴퓨팅 판매를 뜻할 수 있다고 말합니다. 일곱 거래일의 하락은 발표 전날 눈높이를 이익의 약 32배까지 낮춰 줬습니다. 중국 시장이 다시 열리고 있고, 스페이스X는 유일한 공급사로 엔비디아를 골랐습니다.
nvda.bear_en: The price rise is also a margin warning. Memory is a big part of what an AI server costs, memory has got much more expensive, and passing more than 15% of that on either slows the customers' spending or, if it does not stick, comes out of Nvidia's own profit. Tomorrow the company has to say which — into a market that has marked it down seven sessions running, its longest losing run in four years. Cisco and Applied Materials both delivered record quarters this month and were marked down anyway. The financing question still has teeth: Nvidia has promised to stand behind up to $105 billion for its biggest customer while reports link the AI buildout's borrowing to the rise in long-term rates. And the competition keeps moving: AMD agreed on August 6 to acquire Taalas, whose chips build an AI model straight into the silicon.
nvda.bear_ko: 가격 인상은 이익률 경고이기도 합니다. AI 서버 원가에서 메모리가 차지하는 몫은 큽니다. 그 메모리가 훨씬 비싸졌고, 그중 15% 넘는 몫을 고객에게 넘기면 고객들의 지출이 느려지거나, 넘기지 못하면 엔비디아 자신의 이익에서 빠져나갑니다. 내일 회사는 어느 쪽인지 말해야 합니다. 일곱 거래일 연속으로, 4년 만에 가장 길게 자기를 깎아내린 시장 앞에서요. 시스코와 어플라이드 머티어리얼즈는 이달에 사상 최대 분기를 내고도 값이 깎였습니다. 자금 조달 질문에도 여전히 이빨이 있습니다. 엔비디아는 가장 큰 고객을 위해 최대 1,050억 달러를 보증하겠다고 약속했는데, 보도들은 AI 구축의 차입을 장기 금리 상승과 연결짓습니다. 경쟁도 계속 움직입니다. AMD는 8월 6일, AI 모델을 반도체 안에 직접 새겨 넣는 탈라스(Taalas)를 인수하기로 했습니다.

soxl.verdict_en: What I'd watch — and the one thing I would genuinely flag: this is a tool for short trades, not something to hold onto, and the last six sessions have made the argument without needing any help from me. The chip companies it follows are down about 8% since their August 14 close. This is down about 23% over the same six sessions. August, which was +32% for this fund a week ago, is now about −3% — the only one of your five behind for the month. The recovery arithmetic tells it plainest: getting back to its 1-year high needed about 99% on Monday the 17th and needs about 172% now. The next thing that could move it this hard is tomorrow: Nvidia reports Wednesday, August 26, and this fund will move three times whatever the chip index does on the reaction — in either direction, with no way to choose which. If you want to bet on chips into that report, owning Nvidia itself does it with one-third the whiplash.

soxl.plain_en: Read this one carefully — it is by far the riskiest of the five. SOXL is built to move three times as much as chip stocks do, every single day. If chip stocks rise 2%, it rises about 6%. If they fall 2%, it falls about 6%. On Monday chip stocks fell 2.67% — and SOXL fell 7.83%, to $111.16, having been down about 12% during the day. Nothing malfunctioned; that is the design. In July the same machinery cost it 57% of its value while the overall market was flat. It now sits about 63% below its best price of the past year, and getting back there would take a rise of about 172%.

cost.verdict_en: What I'd watch: Costco's own August sales on Wednesday, September 2, then full results on Thursday, September 24 — with Walmart's warning as the backdrop. Walmart's report cuts both ways for this share. Shoppers making trade-offs and hunting value are exactly who Costco serves — its July sales, up 10.7%, say the squeeze has so far pushed people toward its warehouses, and BJ's, the closest listed cousin, beat a week ago Friday. But Walmart also showed how hard the market grades a retailer whose growth slows, and Costco is priced at about 49 times profits. The number to hold onto is still 8.9% — July's sales growth at stores open at least a year. If the September 2 report keeps that pace, Walmart's fall stays Walmart's story; if it slows, Walmart showed the kind of reception to expect. Monday added a smaller thing worth noticing: this is the holding that rises when the AI trade is being sold, and it did it again. The quiet weight has eased slightly but not gone: about 0.6% a year in dividends against a 30-year government bond near 5.23%.
cost.verdict_ko: 제가 지켜볼 것: 9월 2일 수요일 코스트코 자체의 8월 매출, 그리고 9월 24일 목요일의 분기 전체 실적입니다. 월마트의 경고가 그 배경입니다. 월마트의 발표는 이 주식에 양쪽으로 작용합니다. 소비를 저울질하며 가성비를 찾는 손님이야말로 코스트코의 손님입니다. 7월 매출이 10.7% 늘었다는 것은 그 쪼들림이 지금까지는 사람들을 이 창고로 보냈다는 뜻이고, 상장사 중 가장 가까운 사촌인 BJ's는 지난 금요일에 예상을 넘었습니다. 하지만 월마트는 성장이 느려진 유통업체를 시장이 얼마나 매섭게 채점하는지도 보여 줬고, 코스트코의 값은 이익의 약 49배입니다. 기억해 두실 숫자는 여전히 8.9%입니다. 7월에 문을 연 지 1년이 넘은 매장의 매출 증가율입니다. 9월 2일 발표가 그 속도를 지키면 월마트의 하락은 월마트의 이야기로 남습니다. 느려진다면, 어떤 대접을 받게 되는지는 월마트가 보여 줬습니다. 월요일은 작지만 눈여겨볼 것을 하나 보탰습니다. 이 종목은 AI 거래가 팔릴 때 오르는 보유 종목이고, 이번에 또 그렇게 했습니다. 조용한 무게는 조금 가벼워졌지만 사라지지는 않았습니다. 이 주식의 배당은 연 약 0.6%인데 30년물 국채는 5.23% 부근을 줍니다.
cost.plain_en: The warehouse retailer. On Monday it rose 2.50% to $971.40 — its biggest one-day gain since mid-July, and the only one of your five that went up. Nothing came from the company; market reports describe money moving out of the riskier technology shares and into steadier ones. Costco's own business is doing well — July sales up 10.7%, sales at year-old stores up 8.9%. The price is about 11.5% below its peak because the shares had become expensive, not because the company is struggling. For the year it is up about 13.1%.

Walmart's own words argue for Costco: customers making trade-offs and hunting value are exactly who a warehouse club serves, and BJ's — the closest listed comparison — beat expectations the very next day. Monday made the diversifier case in one session: on a day the chip shares were sold and three of your five fell, this one rose 2.50% and pulled August back into the black. The company has also been widening what it sells — last Tuesday it announced its first full Medicare partnership, with the non-profit insurer SCAN, aimed at markets holding around five million Medicare enrollees.

cost.bear_en: At about 49 times profits it is expensive, and the alternative still pays well: about 0.6% a year in dividends against a 30-year government bond near 5.23%. Monday's rise makes it more expensive, not less. Walmart put a date on the worry last Thursday: the country's biggest retailer said its customers are slowing, and was marked down 9% in a session — the first soft answer from a giant, and a preview of how Costco would be graded if its own numbers slow on September 2. A rotation into steady names is also a rented advantage; it lasts as long as investors are nervous about technology and no longer. And the shares are still about 11.5% below their peak, with the year's gain of about 13.1% only just ahead of the market's 11.8%.

week.label_en: Monday August 24, 2026 — one session into the week
week.summary_en: One session into the new week, the market split in two along a line you already know. The chip shares were sold again — but this time for a reason with a number attached, not a mood. Reports said Nvidia has told customers that servers built around its AI chips will cost more than 15% more from early next year, because the memory chips inside them have become so expensive. The market marked down both ends of that: Nvidia fell 2.91%, its seventh down day in a row and its longest losing run in four years, and Micron fell 5.83%, with SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate all down over 5%. The chip gauge lost 2.67%. Everything else was fine, and better than fine: long-term borrowing rates eased after a report that the Treasury may fund its bigger bond buying out of its own $1 trillion account, the 30-year came off its 19-year high to about 5.23%, money moved into steadier companies, and the Dow rose 140.15 points. The Treasury Secretary's Iran plan landed at 11 in the morning Pacific time — more than 60 people, companies and ships sanctioned — and oil fell about 2% rather than rising. The scoreboard: SPX −0.28%, QQQ −1.00%, NVDA −2.91%, SOXL −7.83%, COST +2.50%. For August, four of the five are still ahead; SOXL, at about −3.1%, is now the only one behind.

drivers.headline_en: The one that mattered: the chip selloff finally got a price tag
drivers.headline_ko: 가장 중요했던 것 — 반도체 매도에 드디어 가격표가 붙었습니다
drivers.text_en: For a week the AI shares had been marked down with no bad news at all — the market simply wanted a lower price for the same story. On Monday the story itself changed. Reports said Nvidia has told customers that servers built around its AI chips will cost more than 15% more from early next year, on systems shipping in 2027, because memory prices have climbed so far. That single sentence puts a real bill on the table, and there are only two places it can be paid from: the budgets of the companies buying those servers, or Nvidia's own profit margin. The market did not wait for the answer. Nvidia fell 2.91% — a seventh straight down day, the longest such run in four years — while the memory makers charging the higher prices fell hardest of all: Micron −5.83%, with SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate each down over 5%. Broadcom fell 2.63% and AMD about 3%. The chip gauge lost 2.67%, and SOXL, which triples it, lost 7.83%. The answer has a date: Nvidia reports tomorrow.
drivers.text_ko: 일주일 동안 AI 주식들은 나쁜 소식 하나 없이 깎여 왔습니다. 시장이 같은 이야기에 더 낮은 값을 치르겠다고 했을 뿐이었습니다. 월요일에는 이야기 자체가 바뀌었습니다. 엔비디아가 고객사들에게 자사 AI 반도체를 넣은 서버 가격을 내년 초부터, 2027년 출하분을 기준으로 15% 넘게 올린다고 알렸다는 보도가 나왔습니다. 메모리 값이 그만큼 올랐기 때문입니다. 이 한 문장은 실제로 치러야 할 비용을 탁자 위에 올려놓고, 그 돈이 나올 수 있는 곳은 둘뿐입니다. 그 서버를 사는 회사들의 예산이거나, 엔비디아 자신의 이익률이거나요. 시장은 답을 기다리지 않았습니다. 엔비디아는 2.91% 내려 일곱 거래일 연속 하락, 4년 만에 가장 긴 행진이 됐고, 값을 더 받는 쪽인 메모리 회사들이 가장 크게 내렸습니다. 마이크론 −5.83%였고 샌디스크·웨스턴디지털·시게이트도 각각 5% 넘게 내렸습니다. 브로드컴은 2.63%, AMD는 약 3% 내렸습니다. 반도체 주가지표는 2.67%를 잃었고, 그것을 세 배로 옮기는 SOXL은 7.83%를 잃었습니다. 답에는 날짜가 붙어 있습니다. 엔비디아가 내일 실적을 발표합니다.

drivers.headline_en: The other half of the screen: the bond market eased, and the money went somewhere sensible
drivers.headline_ko: 화면의 다른 절반 — 채권 시장이 풀렸고, 돈은 합리적인 곳으로 갔습니다
drivers.text_en: The pressure that did the damage all last month let up on Monday. After a report that the Treasury could fund its expanded bond buying out of its own $1 trillion account, long-term rates fell: the 10-year to about 4.70% and the 30-year to about 5.23%, off the 19-year high it set a week earlier. Oil helped rather than hurt. The Treasury Secretary announced the plan to squeeze Iran's economy at 11 in the morning Pacific time — more than 60 people, companies and ships sanctioned, and secondary sanctions extended to digital assets, technology, gold, aviation and shipping — and oil fell about 2%, which reporting attributes to profit-taking after two strong weeks and to weekend reports of cargoes getting around the blockade. With rates easier and technology out of favour, money moved to steadier companies: the Dow rose 140.15 points while the Nasdaq fell, and Costco rose 2.50% — the only one of your five to go up, and its biggest daily gain since mid-July. Costco announced nothing itself.
drivers.text_ko: 지난달 내내 피해를 만들던 압력이 월요일에 누그러졌습니다. 재무부가 확대한 국채 되사기를 자기 계좌에 있는 1조 달러로 충당할 수 있다는 보도가 나온 뒤 장기 금리가 내렸습니다. 10년물은 약 4.70%, 30년물은 일주일 전 세운 19년 만의 최고에서 물러나 약 5.23%가 됐습니다. 유가도 해가 아니라 도움이 됐습니다. 재무장관은 서부 시각 오전 11시에 이란 경제를 조이는 계획을 발표했습니다. 60명이 넘는 개인·기업·선박이 제재 대상에 올랐고, 2차 제재 대상 분야에 디지털 자산·기술·금·항공·해운이 더해졌습니다. 그런데 유가는 약 2% 내렸습니다. 보도는 이를 강했던 2주 뒤의 차익 실현과, 봉쇄를 우회하는 화물에 관한 주말 보도들과 연결짓습니다. 금리가 풀리고 기술주가 외면받자 돈은 더 안정적인 회사들로 갔습니다. 나스닥이 내리는 동안 다우존스는 140.15포인트 올랐고, 코스트코는 2.50% 올랐습니다. 보유 다섯 중 유일한 상승이자 7월 중순 이후 하루 상승폭으로는 가장 컸습니다. 코스트코가 발표한 소식은 없었습니다.

lede.en: Yesterday the market split in two. The chip shares were sold hard while almost everything else held up — NVDA −2.91%, QQQ −1.00%, SOXL −7.83%, but the S&P 500 gave up only 0.28% to 7,652.86, the Dow actually rose 140 points, and Costco climbed 2.50% to $971.40, the only one of your five to rise. Nvidia has now fallen seven sessions in a row, its longest losing run in four years — and it reports its own results tomorrow.
lede.ko: 어제 시장은 둘로 갈렸습니다. 반도체 주식은 세게 팔렸지만 나머지는 대부분 버텼습니다. NVDA −2.91%, QQQ −1.00%, SOXL −7.83%였는데 S&P 500은 0.28%만 내려 7,652.86이 됐고, 다우존스는 오히려 140포인트 올랐으며, 코스트코는 2.50% 올라 971.40달러가 됐습니다. 보유 다섯 중 유일한 상승이었습니다. 엔비디아는 이제 일곱 거래일 연속 내렸습니다. 4년 만에 가장 긴 하락 행진이고, 자체 실적은 내일 발표합니다.

lede.en: The reason the chips were sold is new, and it is worth understanding, because it is the first hard number in a story that had been running on mood. Reports said Nvidia has told customers that servers built around its AI chips will cost more than 15% more from early next year — because the memory chips inside them have become so expensive. That is a real bill, and only two people can pay it: the companies buying the servers, or Nvidia out of its own profit. The market marked down both ends of the trade the same day — Micron fell 5.83% — and the answer arrives with Nvidia's results tomorrow.
lede.ko: 반도체가 팔린 이유는 새로운 것이고, 알아 둘 만합니다. 분위기로만 굴러가던 이야기에 처음으로 단단한 숫자가 붙었기 때문입니다. 엔비디아가 고객사들에게 자사 AI 반도체를 넣은 서버 가격을 내년 초부터 15% 넘게 올린다고 알렸다는 보도입니다. 그 안에 든 메모리 반도체 값이 너무 비싸졌기 때문입니다. 이것은 실제로 치러야 할 비용이고, 낼 수 있는 사람은 둘뿐입니다. 서버를 사는 회사들이거나, 자기 이익에서 떼는 엔비디아이거나요. 시장은 같은 날 그 거래의 양쪽 끝을 모두 깎았고(마이크론은 5.83% 하락), 답은 내일 엔비디아 실적과 함께 나옵니다.

lede.en: Two structural things showed up plainly. The first is the four-way overlap this page always flags: one story about chip costs produced −2.91%, −7.83%, −1.00% and −0.28% on the same afternoon, in that order of severity, while the one holding with no chips in it went the other way entirely. The second is SOXL's daily reset: the chip fund fell 2.67% and SOXL fell 7.83%, and getting back to its 1-year high now needs a rise of about 172%, against 99% a week ago Monday. Elsewhere the news was better than it has been in a while — long-term rates eased off their 19-year high, and oil fell about 2% on the day the toughest Iran sanctions yet were announced. The dated tests ahead: the inflation report and Nvidia's results tomorrow, and the new Fed chair's first Jackson Hole speech on Friday at 7 in the morning Pacific time.
lede.ko: 구조적인 사실 둘이 분명하게 드러났습니다. 첫째는 이 페이지가 늘 짚는 네 겹의 중복입니다. 반도체 비용에 관한 이야기 하나가 같은 오후에 −2.91%, −7.83%, −1.00%, −0.28%를 만들었고, 그 크기의 순서까지 그대로였으며, 반도체가 들어 있지 않은 하나만 정반대로 갔습니다. 둘째는 SOXL의 매일 초기화입니다. 반도체 펀드가 2.67% 내릴 때 SOXL은 7.83% 내렸고, 1년 최고가로 돌아가는 데 필요한 상승은 이제 약 172%입니다. 일주일 전 월요일에는 99%였습니다. 다른 쪽 소식은 오랜만에 좋았습니다. 장기 금리는 19년 만의 최고에서 내렸고, 역대 가장 강한 이란 제재가 발표된 날 유가는 약 2% 내렸습니다. 앞의 날짜 있는 시험대는 이렇습니다. 내일의 물가 보고서와 엔비디아 실적, 그리고 금요일 서부 시각 오전 7시 새 연준 의장의 첫 잭슨홀 연설입니다.

today_en: Futures point modestly higher this morning, with the Nasdaq side leading — the chip shares look like they want to steady after yesterday. Nvidia is quoted about 1% higher before the bell, though early quotes are thin and it has fallen seven days running. Nothing among your five reported overnight, and today's calendar is genuinely light: consumer confidence and new home sales at 7 this morning Pacific time, then a government bond auction in the afternoon. Oil is a little lower again. The week's real business is tomorrow — the inflation report before the open and Nvidia's results after the close — so today mostly answers one question: whether the market wants to buy the chip shares back before that number, or wait for it.
today_ko: 오늘 아침 선물은 소폭 올라 있고, 나스닥 쪽이 앞섭니다. 반도체 주식들이 어제의 하락 뒤 자리를 잡으려는 모습입니다. 엔비디아는 개장 전 약 1% 높게 호가되고 있지만, 이른 시각 호가는 거래가 적어 얇고 이 종목은 일곱 거래일 연속 내린 상태입니다. 보유 다섯 종목과 관련해 밤사이 나온 발표는 없었고, 오늘 일정은 정말 한산합니다. 서부 시각 오늘 오전 7시에 소비자 신뢰지수와 신규 주택 판매가 나오고, 오후에는 국채 입찰이 있습니다. 유가는 오늘도 조금 내려 있습니다. 이번 주의 진짜 일정은 내일입니다. 개장 전 물가 보고서와 장 마감 뒤 엔비디아 실적이지요. 그래서 오늘이 답하는 것은 사실상 하나입니다. 시장이 그 숫자를 보기 전에 반도체 주식을 다시 사려 하는지, 아니면 기다리는지입니다.
